# Gala Naturaleza

> Guided birding and nature tours in Cozumel, the Yucatán Peninsula and Chiapas (Mexico), led by wildlife photographer Elvis Jiménez. Bilingual site (English / Spanish).

Gala Naturaleza offers small-group guided birdwatching and wildlife experiences focused on endemic and regional specialty birds. Based in Cozumel, Quintana Roo, Mexico. Payment is made in cash on the day of the tour. Bookings and questions are handled directly via WhatsApp.

## Destinations
- Cozumel: island endemics such as Cozumel Emerald, Cozumel Vireo and Cozumel Wren.
- Yucatán: flamingos, wetlands and peninsular specialties such as Yucatán Gnatcatcher and Black-throated Bobwhite.
- Chiapas: highland and Lacandon jungle birds such as Pink-headed Warbler and Wine-throated Hummingbird.
